title: Phase 1 deterministic dashboard query contract corpus
description: Independent canonical targets for the current dashboard query surface. Runtime enforcement is staged by activationPhase.

routingPolicies.local_reject: Local rejection or clarification; Groq forbidden.
routingPolicies.groq_allowed: At most one repair call; provider failure must return safe clarification.

axes.X: supported exclusion (fuel, category, class, or norm)

baseline.acceptance: No previously passing case may regress. Known target mismatches remain visible until their activation phase.
